verdict.rationale: The BILL v3 API documents real bulk endpoints: `POST /v3/payments/bulk` pays up to 50 bills per request and `POST /v3/payments/mass` pays up to 2000. Record export and CSV import/export add batch data movement. However, the bulk endpoints are documented for AP bill payments, not for Spend & Expense objects such as cards, transactions, budgets or reimbursements. Missing for 10: bulk operations on S&E items (cards, transactions, budgets, reimbursements), bulk create/update beyond payments, independent or hands-on corroboration.
